description: Defines the IOBuffer class and its variants used for asynchronous IO operations in the net namespace, including reference counting, ownership semantics, and various buffer types.

classes.name: IOBuffer
classes.description: Reference counted data buffer for asynchronous IO, managing ownership and lifetime of the underlying data.

classes.name: IOBufferWithSize
classes.description: Extends IOBuffer to include size information.

classes.name: StringIOBuffer
classes.description: Read-only IOBuffer backed by a std::string.

classes.name: DrainableIOBuffer
classes.description: IOBuffer that supports progressive reading and consumption of data.

classes.name: GrowableIOBuffer
classes.description: Resizable IOBuffer for reading data without knowing total size upfront.

classes.name: PickledIOBuffer
classes.description: IOBuffer that uses a base::Pickle for storage, avoiding extra data copies.

classes.name: WrappedIOBuffer
classes.description: Temporary IOBuffer that does not own the underlying buffer.

methods.name: IOBuffer
methods.description: Constructor for IOBuffer.

methods.name: IOBuffer(size_t buffer_size)
methods.description: Creates an IOBuffer with specified size.

methods.name: data()
methods.description: Returns pointer to the buffer data.

methods.name: IOBufferWithSize(size_t size)
methods.description: Creates an IOBuffer with size tracking.

methods.name: size()
methods.description: Returns size of the buffer.

methods.name: StringIOBuffer(const std::string& s)
methods.description: Creates a read-only IOBuffer from a string.

methods.name: StringIOBuffer(std::unique_ptr<std::string> s)
methods.description: Creates a read-only IOBuffer from a unique_ptr to string.

methods.name: DrainableIOBuffer(scoped_refptr<IOBuffer> base, int size)
methods.description: Constructs a drainable buffer with specified size.

methods.name: DrainableIOBuffer(scoped_refptr<IOBuffer> base, size_t size)
methods.description: Constructs a drainable buffer with specified size (size_t).

methods.name: DidConsume(int bytes)
methods.description: Marks bytes as consumed, adjusting internal pointer.

methods.name: BytesRemaining()
methods.description: Returns remaining unconsumed bytes.

methods.name: BytesConsumed()
methods.description: Returns total bytes consumed.

methods.name: SetOffset(int bytes)
methods.description: Sets the current offset in the buffer.

methods.name: RemainingCapacity()
methods.description: Returns remaining capacity in GrowableIOBuffer.

methods.name: StartOfBuffer()
methods.description: Returns pointer to start of buffer in GrowableIOBuffer.

methods.name: SetCapacity(int capacity)
methods.description: Resizes the buffer to specified capacity.

methods.name: PickledIOBuffer()
methods.description: Constructs a PickledIOBuffer.

methods.name: pickle()
methods.description: Returns pointer to the internal base::Pickle object.

methods.name: Done()
methods.description: Marks the pickle as ready for IO operation.

methods.name: WrappedIOBuffer(const char* data)
methods.description: Creates a temporary IOBuffer referencing existing data.
